mapper.select: SELECT course_id, user_id, source_course_id, name, description, creation_type, share_code, view_count, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at FROM course WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO course ( user_id, source_course_id, name, description, creation_type, share_code, view_count, created_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{sourceCourseId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{creationType}, #{shareCode}, 0, SYSTIMESTAMP )
INSERT INTO course_place ( course_id, place_id, visit_order, recommendation_reason, visit_status ) VALUES ( #{courseId}, #{placeId}, #{visitOrder}, #{recommendationReason}, #{visitStatus} )
